Package pl.polsl.dao

Class WordDao

java.lang.Object
pl.polsl.dao.WordDao
public class WordDao extends Object
Data Access Object for Word entity. Provides basic CRUD operations without exception handling as required.

Author:

      public void loadDictionary(InputStream inputStream)

      public Word getRandomWord()
      Selects a random word from the database. Efficiently handles the selection using record counting and pagination offset.
      Returns:
